query: What commercial and research systems automate tensile testing of metal specimens, including robotic specimen loading and unloading (e.g. Instron AT2/AT3/AT6 automated testing systems, ZwickRoell roboTest, Shimadzu), specimen magazines, automatic extensometers, and automated elevated-temperature tensile testing with furnaces or environmental chambers? How are specimens fed, gripped, centered and removed, and what throughputs are reported? Include high-throughput tensile testing of additively manufactured small specimens.
